name: Scott's Tweaks
description: One Scott's Tweaks install for Red, Blue, Yellow, Gold, Silver and Crystal. It keeps each generation's native menus while adding original-style voxel terrain and camera views, visible wild Pokemon and followers, B-button running, Free Fly, Buddy/All EXP sharing, sprite options, physical-Thor dual-screen support, optional ledge depth, lunar phases and Scott's moving block-pixel night-sky photography. Gen 2 can optionally place its untouched native menus on the Thor lower display; Kanto-only story and inventory tweaks remain safely limited to Gen 1. No Stadium models, battles, UI or ROM imports are included.
